description: This file contains ARM assembly code implementing cryptographic multiplication functions for BoringSSL, including montgomery multiplication and squaring routines, with related reduction and conditional subtraction for modular arithmetic.

methods.name: bn_mul_mont
methods.description: Performs Montgomery multiplication of large integers, optimized for ARM AArch64 architecture.

methods.name: __bn_sqr8x_mont
methods.description: Performs optimized squaring of large integers using 8x8 block processing in Montgomery domain.

methods.name: __bn_mul4x_mont
methods.description: Performs Montgomery multiplication of 4-limb blocks, used internally for multi-precision modular arithmetic.
